title: Öğretmen

characters.TEACHER: a female teacher in her fifties with short grey-streaked brown hair and round glasses, wearing a long olive green cardigan
characters.PUPIL: a girl of about ten with a short black bob haircut, wearing a red pinafore over a white shirt
characters.WOMAN: a woman of about thirty with a short black bob haircut, wearing a red blazer
characters.OLDTEACHER: the same teacher, now in her seventies with short white hair and round glasses, wearing a long olive green cardigan

scenes.text:
Seni en çok kızdıran öğretmenin,
belki sana en çok inanandı.
scenes.prompt: In a sunny classroom with autumn trees outside the window, {TEACHER} stands beside the wooden desk of {PUPIL} with a gentle but firm look, an open notebook lies on the desk, {PUPIL} frowns with her arms crossed.

scenes.text:
Ödevini hep geri verir,
"Daha iyisini yaparsın" derdi.
scenes.prompt: {TEACHER} stands at the front of an empty classroom at the end of the day, looking out the window with a quiet hopeful smile, golden autumn leaves falling outside.

scenes.text:
Sen kızar,
o akşam yine baştan yazardın.
scenes.prompt: At night by the light of a desk lamp, {PUPIL} sits at a small desk at home with an open notebook in front of her, a determined face, rain on the window.

scenes.text:
Yıllar sonra zor bir günde,
kendine aynı cümleyi söyledin.
scenes.prompt: In a quiet office at sunset, {WOMAN} sits at her desk with papers in front of her, lifting her head and looking out the window with a determined smile, golden light pouring in.

scenes.text:
Bazı öğretmenler ders değil, ses bırakır.
Bunu öğretmenine gönder.
scenes.prompt: In an autumn schoolyard at sunset, {WOMAN} on the left and {OLDTEACHER} on the right stand under a big tree smiling warmly at each other, golden leaves falling around them.

caption:
Öğretmenini hatırlıyor musun?

Bazı sesler yıllar sonra bile içinden konuşur. 🤍

Bunu öğretmenine gönder.
